audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Null Sphere silences ("it silences and shields", "while he can't silence you") and that its shield blunts Shock Blast. Riot's text for Null Sphere is: fires an orb dealing damage and INTERRUPTING CHANNELS, and the excess energy forms a shield that absorbs MAGIC damage. There is no silence, and a magic shield does nothing against Shock Blast, which is physical.
audit.why: Both errors point the reader the wrong way. He is told to wait out a silence that does not exist, and told the shield eats his cannon poke when in fact the shield is transparent to it — the only Jayce ability the shield and Void Stone actually blunt is Thundering Blow, which is the hammer-stance E and deals magic damage. That inverts the trade: keep poking through the shield, and expect the hammer knockback to be the hit he mitigates.
audit.corrected: Silence removed everywhere; the shield described as magic-only, so cannon Q punches through it and only Thundering Blow is blunted.
sources: champ-data/_kits/kassadin.json (Q Null Sphere: 'dealing damage and interrupting channels... a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage'; P Void Stone: 'takes reduced magic damage')
champ-data/_kits/jayce.json (E Hammer Thundering Blow: 'Deals magic damage'; Q Cannon Shock Blast: physical damage)

audit.whatIsWrong: Every spike and why names Shock Blast, Thundering Blow and Riftwalk as the deciding abilities, and not one cooldown number appears anywhere.
audit.why: Shock Blast is 16/14/12/10/8/6s, Thundering Blow 20/18/16/14/12/10s, the Mercury Cannon/Mercury Hammer swap a flat 6s, and Riftwalk 5/3.5/2s. Those numbers turn 'commit before he scales' into a schedule: the swap being 6s means a Jayce who just gated a Shock Blast in cannon form cannot reach the hammer for six seconds, and a rank-1 Riftwalk on 5s means the level-6 escape is not yet spammable — the window closes at rank 2, not rank 1.
audit.corrected: Swap 6s, Shock Blast 16s and Riftwalk 5/3.5/2s written into the level-6 spike, the mid block and wants.you.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Jayce six of seven stages with Skill at Level 6, so no stage reads Kassadin — while the page's own late block says a two-item Riftwalk Kassadin 'double-blinks onto your squishy frame, one-shots you, and Riftwalks back out'.
audit.why: The chart and the prose disagree at the exact stage the prose calls a loss. The mirror audit (audits/top/kassadin__jayce.json) already flipped 2+ items to Kassadin on that side, so leaving Jayce here would put the two pages in direct contradiction.
audit.corrected: 2+ items flipped to Kassadin in both layers, matching the mirror. Every earlier stage left as-is.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells the reader to bait or wait out Null Sphere before trading, without naming the thing Null Sphere actually does to Jayce.
audit.why: Null Sphere interrupts channels — it does not silence — and it is a 650-range single-target projectile on 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s. Against Jayce that means it is a poke-answer, not a trade-stopper: if it is on cooldown he has literally nothing that reaches you in cannon form, because Force Pulse is 400 range and needs spell charges first.
audit.corrected: Trading advice keyed to Null Sphere's 9s cooldown and Force Pulse's 400 range instead of a fictional silence.
sources: champ-data/_kits/kassadin.json (Q range 650, CD 9/8.5/8/7.5/7; E Force Pulse range 400, 'draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity')

edits.after: Acceleration Gate comes online — gate-Q a full-range Shock Blast at his casters and the Mercury Cannon swap shreds his armour and MR on the first hit, so any walk-up gets chunked. Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic only and never blunts the orb.

edits.after: Riftwalk online — he blinks out of To the Skies! and Thundering Blow. At rank 1 it is 5s, so one blink is all he gets; the window only truly shuts at rank 2 (3.5s) and rank 3 (2s).

edits.before: Kassadin is one of the weakest melee laners into a Cannon-form caster — he has to walk into Shock Blast range to last-hit and his early Null Sphere shield is thin, so abuse it. Fire the orb THROUGH Acceleration Gate so it hits full range and full damage, then if he steps up, swap Mercury Cannon into Mercury Hammer — the first hit shreds his MR and you chunk him. Don't auto blindly into his Null Sphere: it silences and shields, so either bait it on nothing or wait it out, because once it's down he has no answer to your Cannon-Q into Hammer combo.
edits.after: Kassadin is one of the weakest melee laners into a Cannon-form caster — he has to walk into Shock Blast range to last-hit and cannot answer it, so abuse that. Fire the orb THROUGH Acceleration Gate for full range and damage, then if he steps up swap Mercury Cannon into Mercury Hammer — the first hit shreds his armour AND his MR. His Null Sphere shield only absorbs magic damage, so it does nothing to the physical orb; it does not silence either. Trade on its 9s cooldown and he has no answer at all.

edits.before: You own the poke war through Levels 4-5 — keep gate-Q chipping him and deny his stacks, because every chunk of health you take now is health he needs to survive to scale. The whole lane pivots at Level 6: Riftwalk lets him blink out of your To the Skies leap and out of Thundering Blow range, so don't throw the knockback when he can just Riftwalk it. Force your all-in BEFORE he has the mana to chain Riftwalks away, and ping your jungler — a low-health Kassadin with no escape mana is the easiest gank on the map.
edits.after: You own the poke war through Levels 4-5 — keep gate-Q chipping him, because every chunk you take now is health he needs to scale. The lane pivots at 6: Riftwalk blinks him out of To the Skies! and out of Thundering Blow, so don't throw the 20s knockback when he can just blink it. Remember your own swap is 6 seconds — a gated Shock Blast in cannon form means no hammer for six, so open the all-in with the swap, not with the orb. Ping your jungler; a Kassadin with no blink mana is the easiest gank on the map.

edits.before: Riftwalk comes online at 6 — he blinks out of To the Skies and Thundering Blow, your all-in window closes, and his mobility starts winning him roams.
edits.after: Riftwalk at 6 blinks him out of To the Skies! and the 20s Thundering Blow — at rank 1 it is 5s, so he still only gets one escape per trade.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s: rank 1 is one escape, rank 3 is unpunishable. Kill him before it scales. - Null Sphere is 9s and shields MAGIC only — it never stops Shock Blast. - Your swap is a flat 6s: cannon out means no Thundering Blow.

edits.before: Track Kassadin's Riftwalk: His mobility spike at 6. Kill him before it scales. When it is down — Gate-Q poke + hammer knock.
edits.after: Null Sphere shields magic only, so the physical Shock Blast goes straight through it. Thundering Blow is the one hit Void Stone blunts.

notes: FACTUAL ERROR (two of them, same ability): the page said Null Sphere "silences and shields" and told the reader Kassadin can "use its shield to blunt the Shock Blast". Riot's own text says Null Sphere interrupts channels — no silence — and the shield absorbs MAGIC damage. Shock Blast is physical, so the shield is transparent to Jayce's entire poke plan; the only Jayce ability it (and Void Stone) genuinely blunts is Thundering Blow, which is the magic-damage hammer E. The reader was being told to wait out a silence that does not exist and to expect his poke to be absorbed when it isn't. This matches the mirror audit's finding from Kassadin's side. Cooldowns added: swap 6s flat, Shock Blast 16/14/12/10/8/6s, Thundering Blow 20/18/16/14/12/10s, Null Sphere 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, Riftwalk 5/3.5/2s. LEVEL CHART: no stage read Kassadin though content.late describes losing the 2-item 1v1 outright; flipped 2+ items in both layers to match audits/top/kassadin__jayce.json, which flipped the same stage.
